items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh, my girlfriend . . . my uncle, Dr. Horn, had horses out at Longview, and he had given me a horse, a beautiful black horse whose name was Imp. We were going to go riding, and my dad was going to take us. Then this terrible thunderstorm came up, so when it slacked off I said, ―Mother, we can‘t go riding. Can I go to the movie?‖ And I went to the theater around the corner from my house. I was going to buy some soda or something, and this guy was there, and I thought it was the same guy who used to groom the…
And did you start courting immediately after that?
